notes: Field decisions (rso-builder 2.7). FD-T016-1 traces are written with checker.make_trace (the consumer's format writer and validator) so producer and consumer cannot drift; reversible by copying the format. FD-T016-2 a BoundsViolation during the run makes every non-BOUNDS receipt BLOCKED with missing BOUNDS_VIOLATION:<bound>; the P0 BOUNDS outcome itself stays the caller's (world.py docstring). FD-T016-3 dependencies are B6.2's required_deps of the node id (policy), never chosen by the producer. FD-T016-4 expected_answer.row_id is the node id. FD-T016-5 inputs.domain is a fixed description of the enumeration and reset_model_sha256 hashes the registered (L, j, H, K, S, Q). Revisit at T020 or on an S3 attack.
